statement: Linux requests feature 0x09 (20-byte pairing/MAC) and 0x20 (64-byte firmware info); firmware offsets include hardware and software version fields and an update-version feature discriminator.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 90-95, 1150-1204. These are host decoder fields; no per-device serial, calibration or pairing contents imported.
